title: The Glass Orchard
synopsis: An exiled botanist returns to a frozen city where every tree has been replaced by singing glass.

direction.subject: An exiled botanist in a heavy tattered coat reaching out to touch a crystalline tree.
direction.setting: A frozen, desolate city where organic life has been replaced by sprawling, translucent glass orchards under a twilight sky.
direction.palette: Glacial blues, deep indigo, and sharp spectrum-prism rainbows.
direction.composition: Cinematic wide angle with leading lines created by the glass branches.
continuity_rules: The botanist always wears a dark, fur-lined tattered coat
Glass trees must be translucent with glowing internal veins
Constant presence of atmospheric frost particles
direction.cover_prompt: Cinematic 16:9 wide shot, an exiled botanist standing in a frozen city square filled with towering singing glass trees, translucent crystalline branches refracting twilight light into rainbows, sharp detail, ethereal atmosphere, hyper-realistic digital art.
